Cudy WR1200 AC1200 Dual Band 5GHz  Wifi Router


Boost your internet performance with the Cudy WR1200 AC1200 Dual Band WiFi Router, designed to provide ultra-fast speeds of up to 1200Mbps (300Mbps on 2.4GHz + 867Mbps on 5GHz). Perfect for high-speed streaming, online gaming, and supporting multiple devices, this powerful router ensures stable and seamless connections in both small and large homes or offices.

With dual-band technology, the WR1200 delivers minimal interference and faster speeds on the 5GHz band while maintaining compatibility with older devices on the 2.4GHz band. Whether you're streaming HD video, playing online games, or working remotely, this router provides consistent and reliable internet performance.


Key Features of Cudy WR1200 AC1200 Dual Band WiFi Router:

  • AC1200 Dual Band Speed: 300Mbps (2.4GHz) + 867Mbps (5GHz) for high-speed internet access
  • Dual-Band Technology: Seamless, interference-free performance for all your devices
  • Advanced WPA3 Security: Secure your network with the latest encryption standards
  • Easy Setup with Cudy App: Quick and simple installation from your mobile device
  • Perfect for Streaming, Gaming & Smart Homes: Supports multiple devices with ease
  • 4x LAN Ports & 1x WAN Port: Ideal for wired connections in addition to Wi-Fi
  • Compact & Sleek Design: Fits seamlessly into your home or office setup

Why Choose the Cudy WR1200 AC1200 Dual Band Router?

  • High-Speed Internet: Up to 1200Mbps for faster downloads, seamless streaming, and lag-free gaming.
  • Enhanced WiFi Coverage: Dual-band router offers wider coverage for your entire home or office.
  • Secure & Safe: WPA3 encryption for the highest level of security, protecting your network from threats.
